The Raschuk Sector Fleet was an Imperial naval unit under the command of Admiral [[Devlia]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] battle of Endor where he lead it against both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a bombing run on his headquarters on Grand Isle, [[Vladet]].
